description:
Advances: ancora.scaffold

Found by the ancora-xla.5 test critic, 2026-09-03. Not blocking anything; filed standalone because test/ancora/scaffold/docs_test.exs is outside ancora-xla.5's Allowed touches.

Problem: test/ancora/scaffold/docs_test.exs:13-17 scans the README's Public API section for backticked names and asserts the set equals the old three tokens. ancora-xla.5 adds two more public functions, Ancora.check/2 and Ancora.validate/2. The section now says "four functions" and lists four, but the two new ones were written as markdown hyperlinks rather than backticked code, so the backtick scan still returns exactly the old set and the equality still holds.

The assertion therefore passes for the wrong reason. Worse, it is a landmine: backticking the two new names, which is the obvious consistency edit anyone would make to that README, BREAKS a currently passing test. The next person to tidy the docs gets a failure that looks unrelated to what they did.

This is not a coverage hole. test/mix/tasks/cli_docs_test.exs:7 and test/mix/tasks/public_api_test.exs:33 both pin all four names and both fail at the pre-xla.5 base, so the public API surface itself is genuinely proven. What is broken is only this one assertion's ability to mean what it says.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: test/ancora/scaffold/docs_test.exs, and the two tests above must keep failing at a base without the new functions
- Behaviors to demonstrate: (1) the assertion pins the four names actually documented, by whatever markup the README uses; (2) backticking the two hyperlinked names in the README does NOT break the test; (3) removing a name from the README's Public API section DOES break it
- Verification cadence: iteration tier is the named test files plus mix spec.validate; final tier is the full repo command set before reporting.

Allowed touches:
- test/ancora/scaffold/docs_test.exs
- README.md (Public API section markup only)
- .spec/specs/ancora.scaffold.spec.md (only if this ticket's change falsifies a stated rule there)
- .spec/decisions/** (forced: any .spec/specs/ change without a decision-record change in the same diff fires change/missing_decision)

Out of Scope:
- the public API itself; this ticket changes a test and at most README markup
- lib/** of any kind

Note on shape, per the epic's governing principle: prefer making the assertion read the real documented set over adding machinery. If the honest fix is that this assertion duplicates cli_docs_test and should be deleted rather than repaired, that is an acceptable outcome and should be argued in the completion record.

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors
- [ ] mix test
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted
- [ ] mix deps.unlock --check-unused
- [ ] mix spec.check ends result=pass
title: Stale backtick pin in scaffold docs test passes for the wrong reason
